args.summary: Six laptops have telemetry findings that could make them candidates for wipe and reimage (or replacement for hardware issues): acme-macbook-1, acme-thinkpad-8, acme-dell-9, acme-macbook-4, acme-macbook-2, and acme-macbook-3. Issues include battery end-of-life, persistent low storage, RAM pressure, prohibited software, and screen-lock compliance drift.

claims.text: acme-macbook-1 (7VP16KHV88LM) has a battery reported as "Service Recommended" since 2026-05-30 with cycle count 1049.

acme-thinkpad-8 (8NM23J95R5I6) has three concurrent issues: battery "Service Recommended" since 2026-05-23 (cycle count 1157), persistent low storage at 2.6% free (26 GB of 1024 GB) across 25 of 30 snapshots, and screen_lock compliance drift failing since 2026-05-30 (14 consecutive failures).
acme-dell-9 (M4XVHUV1MEPZ) has battery "Service Recommended" since 2026-05-24 (cycle count 948) and persistent RAM constraint at or above 95% usage in 15 of 30 snapshots on a 16 GB device.
acme-macbook-4 (MT7PJB7N5LRE) has persistent low storage at 2.0% free (10 GB of 512 GB) across all 30 snapshots and screen_lock compliance drift failing since 2026-05-28 (16 consecutive failures).
acme-macbook-2 (1LYSSFD074BB) has prohibited software uTorrent (version 3.6) installed since 2026-05-31 and screen_lock compliance drift failing since 2026-05-22 (22 consecutive failures).
acme-macbook-3 (DSYPSES7SKBB) has screen_lock compliance drift failing since 2026-06-01 (12 consecutive failures).

caveats: Telemetry covers 2026-05-14 to 2026-06-12 only; no data outside this window.
Battery EOL findings are based on device-reported condition "Service Recommended"; hardware replacement may be needed rather than reimage.
RAM constrained finding is based on one daily reading; high usage at that moment, not proof of sustained memory pressure.
Low storage trends show decreasing free space; upgrade or cleanup may be needed.
Compliance drift for screen_lock indicates a medium-severity check that previously passed now fails consistently.
